description: This Java interface defines the structure and methods for message headers used in the Eclipse Ditto messaging system. It includes methods for creating and manipulating message header instances, retrieving header properties such as direction, subject, thing ID, feature ID, content type, timeout, timestamp, and status code. It emphasizes immutability and provides static factory methods for instantiation from maps and JSON objects.

classes.name: MessageHeaders
classes.description: An interface representing immutable headers for messages in the Eclipse Ditto system, providing methods to create, access, and manipulate message header data.

classes.name: MessageHeadersBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing immutable MessageHeaders instances, supporting creation from maps or JSON objects, and method chaining.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for message headers with specified direction, thing ID, and subject.

methods.name: newBuilderForClaiming
methods.description: Creates a new builder for claim message headers using a thing ID.

methods.name: of (Map)
methods.description: Creates a MessageHeaders instance from a map of string key-value pairs.

methods.name: of (JsonObject)
methods.description: Creates a MessageHeaders instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder pre-populated with the properties of this headers instance for modifications.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Retrieves the direction of the message (from or to).

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Retrieves the subject string of the message.

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve the ID of the thing; use getThingEntityId() instead.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the typed ID of the thing involved in the message.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Optionally retrieves the feature ID associated with the message.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Optionally retrieves the content type of the message payload.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Optionally retrieves the timeout duration for the message.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Optionally retrieves the message's HTTP status code.
